world.golden_age.desc: A city that worships beauty: pigment costs more than bread, a name weighs more than gold, and the summer seems never to end.
golden_age.npc.1.desc: A dyer's widow whose hands are steeped in indigo all year; she loves pigment more than blood.
golden_age.npc.1.l1: Blue needs three days to settle—then it shows a person true.
golden_age.npc.1.l2: Keep your hands busy; idle hands grow weeds.
golden_age.npc.2.desc: A salon hostess who can judge a painting's life or death in three sentences.
golden_age.npc.2.l1: Darling, what this lacks isn't light—it's nerve.
golden_age.npc.2.l2: Come for tea, and let me see what you're afraid of.
golden_age.npc.3.desc: A failed old painter who now only blazons wedding crests in taverns.
golden_age.npc.3.l1: I'm not teaching you to paint—I'm teaching you not to be fooled by a painting.
golden_age.npc.3.l2: Paint a hundred eggs before you speak of your soul.
golden_age.npc.4.desc: The reigning young painter, his sword polished brighter than his brushes.
golden_age.npc.4.l1: Your colors are honest—a pity honesty doesn't sell.
golden_age.npc.4.l2: Come talk to me when your name hangs on the gallery wall.
golden_age.npc.5.desc: The guild's treasurer, holding the seal of who may open a shop and take apprentices.
golden_age.npc.5.l1: Paid your dues? Rules arrive before talent.
golden_age.npc.5.l2: The guild doesn't raise geniuses; it raises names.
golden_age.npc.6.desc: Your sister, lead chorister at the church, her voice bright as freshly mixed gilt.
golden_age.npc.6.l1: Brother, can we afford coal this winter?
golden_age.npc.6.l2: I dreamed you finished that painting and smiled so wide.
golden_age.npc.7.desc: Twin apprentices who whisper in each other's ears; no telling who paints and who signs.
golden_age.npc.7.l1: We each painted half—do you want the left or the right?
golden_age.npc.7.l2: Guess which hand painted last night?
golden_age.npc.8.desc: The cathedral's blind organist, who hears every hesitation in your brush.
golden_age.npc.8.l1: Your lines are more honest today than yesterday.
golden_age.npc.8.l2: Don't fear the dark—I saved you a seat in it long ago.
golden_age.npc.9.desc: Your model and your mirror, knowing better than anyone which stroke you're faking.
golden_age.npc.9.l1: Are you painting me, or the self you wish to be?
golden_age.npc.9.l2: Sitting long makes one old too—you'd best hurry.
golden_age.npc.10.desc: The cardinal's red-robed broker, buying eternity with gold, and silence with gold.
golden_age.npc.10.l1: I'm buying your afterlife, not your today.
golden_age.npc.10.l2: Paint a little better, and I'll forgive your birth.
golden_age.era.1.desc: The city was small; painting lived only on monastery grey, color a light the poor borrowed from heaven.
golden_age.era.2: The Year the Guild Lit Its Lamp
golden_age.era.2.desc: Painters banded into rules; the first undying lamp hung in the guild hall, and who held the brush held a name.
golden_age.era.3.desc: Merchant ships brought ultramarine and gold leaf; the whole city learned to shine, and to price its shine.
golden_age.era.4.desc: Three chapel domes broke ground at once; everyone argued whose hand reached nearer heaven.
golden_age.era.5: The Year of Renown and Fire
golden_age.era.5.desc: Gallery walls outvalued church walls—until a fire swallowed half a street.
golden_age.era.6.desc: A summer without end; the wheat ripened and ripened, and no brush ever stopped.
golden_age.fac.1.desc: It lights the lamp, sets the price, certifies the apprentice: one word makes a man or buries him.
golden_age.fac.2.desc: Hung with the city's finest paintings, and with its most expensive favors.
golden_age.fac.3.desc: Those outside the guild and unsponsored—poor, but willing to risk a stroke.
golden_age.fac.4.desc: Bound to the cathedral, tuning power with hymns, singing glory until it sounds like faith.
golden_age.fac.5.desc: The great who buy eternity with gold; between kindness and calculation lies one leaf of gilt.
golden_age.reg.1.desc: A guild garden where pigment-makers test new sap and earth.
golden_age.reg.2.desc: Sloped orchards and presses outside the walls; its harvest sets the city's wine price.
golden_age.reg.3.desc: Where merchant ships land, and ultramarine and foreign tales come ashore.
golden_age.reg.4.desc: A courtyard of models and poets, the air thick with turpentine and whispers.
golden_age.reg.5.desc: The gallery's atrium, daylight pouring from the dome; here people are lit, and compared.
golden_age.reg.6.desc: Flowers, and festival pigment—loud, bright, and cheap.
golden_age.reg.7.desc: The day's last light falls on the water; painters jostle here to catch it.
golden_age.lore.1.body: The first painters had no pigment—only ash, charcoal, and wall. They painted God, because God was the only subject that could pay.
golden_age.lore.2.body: An ounce of ultramarine cost a month's wages. A painter is said to have pawned his wedding ring just to make the Virgin's robe tell the truth.
golden_age.lore.3.body: "None unmastered may sign." That rule fed the rules, and starved no small number of geniuses.
golden_age.lore.4.body: Three chapels broke ground at once, three painters each claimed to be the city's only hand, and the city wagered three years on it.
golden_age.lore.5.body: Ambition is the heaviest pigment: it lifts a painting to the dome, and brings its painter to his knees.
golden_age.lore.6.body: A true teacher won't tell you what to paint; he only pauses when you hand him the brush.
golden_age.lore.7.body: There is a kindness in this city: buying unsalable paintings, so their makers can still afford ultramarine.
golden_age.lore.8.body: Some said paint man, not God; the church named it heresy, and galleries a century later named it a beginning.
golden_age.lore.9.body: Every painter who crossed the wall knows: a homeland's colors reveal their depth only abroad.
golden_age.lore.10.body: At sixty you understand: the gallery wall hangs not paintings, but the you that others chose to believe.
golden_age.lore.11.body: In a far corner of the cathedral hangs half a nameless painting: matchless brushwork, deliberately left blank; who made it is a mystery still.
golden_age.lore.12: The One Who Saw Too Well
golden_age.lore.12.body: The clearer the seeing, the harder the stroke—the greatest masters left their last work blank.
golden_age.lore.13.body: Before thirty you must write a list: whom to please, whom to offend, what to leave behind.
golden_age.lore.14.body: The palette at forty-five is hardest to mix: half what you still want to paint, half what you must.
golden_age.lore.15.body: Someone signed your painting as his own—and so you could afford pigment; the hand that makes you famous may not be yours.
golden_age.lore.16.body: He burned every painting he had. The true masterpiece, he said, lives only in the mind; fire is the finest frame.
golden_age.fate.1.desc: Your name will be carved beneath the dome—at the price of never painting anything nameless again.
golden_age.fate.2.desc: You'll grow rich enough to buy another's whole life, yet never buy back your own morning hand.
golden_age.fate.3.desc: You'll carry your brush across borders and sell your homeland's colors abroad for a foreign meal.
golden_age.fate.4.desc: Your voice won't belong to you, but to the dome, and to everyone who ever heard it.
golden_age.fate.5.desc: You'll gild the edges of other people's stories; your own stays forever on the back of a draft.
golden_age.fate.6.desc: You'll outlive your teacher, then finish the stroke he never could.
golden_age.we.1.body: For the first time the city's paintings hang on one wall—and for the first time someone weeps for second place.
golden_age.we.2.body: The church lights a hundred thousand candles; the survivors suddenly feel that living itself is a kind of color.
golden_age.we.3.body: The free painters walk out, and the word "freedom" enters a guild petition for the first time.
golden_age.we.4.body: A star hangs over the city three nights; painters dare not set brush to paper, fearing they'll paint their own ending.
golden_age.we.5.body: The cardinal's red-robed broker is dead; the afterlife he bought has no heir, and the gallery grows cheap overnight.
golden_age.we.6.body: Wheat ripens three seasons over, brushes run hot three seasons over, and people begin to suspect summer is a punishment.
golden_age.plugin.desc: Comings and goings of guild, gallery, and letter of recommendation.
golden_age.beh.care.2.res: Your wounds were bound with care.
golden_age.beh.care.3: Sits up with you all night
golden_age.beh.care.3.res: Someone sat by your sickbed all night.
golden_age.beh.meal.1: Brings a bowl of hot soup
golden_age.beh.meal.1.res: A bowl of soup warmed you through.
golden_age.beh.meal.2: Leaves half a basket of figs
golden_age.beh.coin.1: Presses a handful of silver on you
golden_age.beh.coin.1.res: Your purse grew a little heavier.
golden_age.beh.coin.2.res: Someone settled your pigment shop's account.
golden_age.beh.coin.3: Lends you a bag of gold
golden_age.beh.coin.3.res: A bag of gold eased your trouble.
golden_age.beh.talk.1: Chats with you about the weather
golden_age.beh.talk.2: Debates the art world with you
golden_age.beh.talk.2.res: A talk let you read the wind.
golden_age.beh.talk.3.res: After the long talk you were no longer alone.
golden_age.beh.teach.2.res: You glimpsed the secret of composition.
golden_age.beh.train.2.res: You steadied your step up high.
golden_age.beh.train.3: Teaches you to stand on ropes
golden_age.beh.train.3.res: You learned to paint at height.
golden_age.beh.warn.1.res: You dodged the talk in time.
golden_age.beh.warn.2: Warns you to be wary of patrons
golden_age.beh.warn.3: Urges you not to cross the guild
golden_age.beh.gift.1: Gives you a small jar of ultramarine
golden_age.beh.gift.2.res: A good brush steadied your line.
golden_age.beh.gift.3.res: An old drawing lit up your studio.
golden_age.beh.song.2.res: The song reminded you of far places.
golden_age.beh.rest.1: Lets you doze on a shoulder
golden_age.beh.rest.1.res: A nap gave you a moment's rest.
golden_age.beh.rest.2: Closes the shutters against the light
golden_age.beh.rest.2.res: The room dimmed and you slept deeper.
golden_age.beh.rest.3.res: You slept a dreamless, good sleep.
golden_age.beh.debt.2: Asks you to settle his account
golden_age.beh.debt.2.res: You paid an old debt for someone.
golden_age.beh.debt.3: Makes you cover a huge sum
golden_age.beh.debt.3.res: A great sum went out and never came back.
golden_age.beh.rumor.2: Speaks ill of your painting behind you
golden_age.beh.rumor.2.res: Someone belittled your work behind your back.
golden_age.beh.taunt.1: Mocks your brushwork to your face
golden_age.beh.taunt.3.res: The sneer kept you up at night.
golden_age.beh.scheme.2.res: A whole jar of pigment was destroyed.
golden_age.beh.scheme.3: Complains about you to the guild
golden_age.beh.upkeep.1.res: The studio was set in order.
golden_age.beh.upkeep.3.res: An exhibition built you a stage.
golden_age.off.visit.1: Someone invites you to their home.
golden_age.off.visit.1.text: Someone asks you to their home, saying it's only old talk, no business.
golden_age.off.visit.1.yes.res: You went to a warm appointment.
golden_age.off.visit.1.no.res: You declined; they seemed let down.
golden_age.off.visit.2: Someone invites you to a private supper.
golden_age.off.visit.2.text: Someone invites you to a private supper, where everyone can make your career.
golden_age.off.visit.2.yes.res: The supper brought you a patron.
golden_age.off.visit.2.no.res: You dodged a night of obligations.
golden_age.off.favor.1.text: Someone asks a small favor, saying it's nothing at all.
golden_age.off.favor.1.yes.res: You helped; the favor is remembered.
golden_age.off.favor.1.no.res: You didn't help; they remembered it.
golden_age.off.favor.2: Someone asks you to stand surety.
golden_age.off.favor.2.text: Someone asks you to stand surety, staking your name on him.
golden_age.off.venture.1: Someone offers you a share in a small trade.
golden_age.off.venture.1.text: Someone offers you a share in a small trade: little capital, little risk.
golden_age.off.venture.2: Someone asks you to fund an exhibition.
golden_age.off.venture.2.text: Someone asks you to fund an exhibition; the gallery wall already waits for him.
golden_age.off.venture.2.yes.res: The show opened, and your name went on the wall.
golden_age.off.feast.1: Someone invites you to a family meal.
golden_age.off.feast.1.text: Someone invites you to a family meal, saying it's plain fare.
golden_age.off.feast.1.yes.res: A family meal turned into a friendship.
golden_age.off.feast.2: Someone invites you to the guild table.
golden_age.off.feast.2.text: Someone invites you to the guild's long table, where the seat is the rank.
golden_age.off.feast.2.yes.res: You held a place at the guild table.
golden_age.off.feast.2.no.res: You drifted further from the guild.
golden_age.off.secret.1: Someone wants to tell you a private matter.
golden_age.off.secret.1.text: Someone wants to tell you a private matter; hearing it, he says, you'll understand.
golden_age.off.secret.1.yes.res: You learned what you shouldn't have.
golden_age.off.secret.2: Someone wants to entrust you a secret.
golden_age.off.secret.2.text: Someone wants to entrust you a secret that has bowed his head for years.
golden_age.off.secret.2.yes.res: A secret now weighs on you.
golden_age.off.duel.1.text: Someone challenges you in public; the stake is only a little face.
golden_age.off.duel.1.no.res: You stepped back and lost face.
golden_age.off.duel.2: Someone stakes his name against yours.
golden_age.off.duel.2.text: Someone stakes his name against yours; the whole city waits for the result.
golden_age.off.duel.2.yes.res: After a hard bout, your name rang louder.
golden_age.off.trade.1: Someone wants to trade with you.
golden_age.off.trade.1.text: Someone wants to trade with you, at a fair price.
golden_age.off.trade.2: Someone offers a famous painting for your manuscript.
golden_age.off.trade.2.text: Someone offers a famous painting for your manuscript, saying each gets what he needs.
golden_age.off.trade.2.no.res: You kept the manuscript, and lost the painting.
golden_age.off.journey.1: Someone asks you along to the next city.
golden_age.off.journey.1.text: Someone asks you along to the next city, a matter of days.
golden_age.off.journey.1.yes.res: A short trip opened your eyes.
golden_age.off.journey.1.no.res: You stayed; all was as before.
golden_age.off.journey.2: Someone asks you to join a caravan.
golden_age.off.journey.2.text: Someone asks you to join a caravan, to see other places' colors.
golden_age.off.journey.2.yes.res: The journey brought back foreign colors.
golden_age.off.journey.2.no.res: You stayed and finished old drafts.
golden_age.ev.stranger.1.text: A foreign dealer stops you in the Garden, saying he has a batch of ultramarine of unclear origin.
golden_age.ev.stranger.1.listen.note: The price he whispers tempts you.
golden_age.ev.stranger.1.turn.note: He shrugs and goes to find another buyer.
golden_age.ev.stranger.2.text: A wandering man in the press-house below the hill claims he has seen the painting you never finished.
golden_age.ev.stranger.2.listen.note: The details he describes only you could know.
golden_age.ev.stranger.2.turn.note: He curses and stumbles off, drunk.
golden_age.ev.stranger.3.text: A broker fresh off the ship offers to resell your paintings in the city across the sea.
golden_age.ev.stranger.3.listen.note: The price is good, but he wants the signature changed.
golden_age.ev.stranger.3.turn.note: You would rather wait for a buyer who knows his trade.
golden_age.ev.stranger.4.text: A masked collector in the Court hands you a card, asking for a painting that cannot bear your name.
golden_age.ev.stranger.4.listen.note: The fee is rich; the terms are dark.
golden_age.ev.stranger.4.turn.note: You refuse, but you remember that mask.
golden_age.ev.theft.1.text: While the crowd jostles for the last light on the pier, someone pulls a stack of sketches from your paint box.
golden_age.ev.theft.1.chase.note: You catch him at the alley mouth and reclaim one torn corner.
golden_age.ev.theft.1.yield.note: A painting can be redone, but you grieve all night.
golden_age.ev.theft.2.text: In the crush of the market, a hand slips away with your freshly mixed jar of ultramarine.
golden_age.ev.theft.2.chase.note: You seize a boy; weeping, he says he took it for someone else.
golden_age.ev.theft.2.yield.note: You cannot afford a second jar and switch to cheap blue.
golden_age.ev.theft.3.text: On exhibition night, a small painting hung in the corner vanishes.
golden_age.ev.theft.3.chase.note: It turns out the guild 'borrowed' it as a sample.
golden_age.ev.theft.3.yield.note: You tell yourself it was not good enough anyway.
golden_age.ev.theft.4.text: A porter, in the chaos of unloading, makes off with a frame you had stored.
golden_age.ev.theft.4.chase.note: You catch him; he kneels and begs you not to tell.
golden_age.ev.theft.4.yield.note: The money is gone; you learn to guard your crate in a crowd.
golden_age.ev.illness.1.text: The summer is too hot; fever spreads around Cider Hill, and you begin to shiver.
golden_age.ev.illness.1.nurse.note: You finish the commission in fever, and keep the ache.
golden_age.ev.illness.1.avoid.note: You dodge the sickness, and the harvest.
golden_age.ev.illness.2.text: A merchant ship brings a strange illness; coughs echo at Bright Shore by night.
golden_age.ev.illness.2.nurse.note: You fall ill, and learn the temperature of people.
golden_age.ev.illness.2.avoid.note: You stay safe, and are called a coward.
golden_age.ev.illness.3.text: Someone on the next street is sick; the clinic lamp burns all night.
golden_age.ev.illness.3.nurse.note: The medicine you bring saves a child.
golden_age.ev.illness.3.avoid.note: You save yourself, and feel uneasy.
golden_age.ev.illness.4.text: The church shelters the sick; there is no room, and someone begs for your hands.
golden_age.ev.illness.4.nurse.note: You tend the sick till you cannot stand, and gain a good name.
golden_age.ev.illness.4.avoid.note: You turn away; chanting follows you out.
golden_age.ev.windfall.1: A Turn of Fortune · The Shore
golden_age.ev.windfall.1.text: A painting you consigned years ago at Bright Shore sells for a high price.
golden_age.ev.windfall.1.invest.note: You stake the money on the pigment trade.
golden_age.ev.windfall.1.save.note: You store it and sleep soundly.
golden_age.ev.windfall.2: A Turn of Fortune · The Market
golden_age.ev.windfall.2.text: A patron from out of town recognizes your hand and pays a deposit.
golden_age.ev.windfall.2.invest.note: You hire apprentices; the studio comes alive.
golden_age.ev.windfall.2.save.note: You pocket the deposit as if it were a dream.
golden_age.ev.windfall.3.text: The church settles the mural wages it owed for years.
golden_age.ev.windfall.3.invest.note: You buy the gold leaf you had long wanted.
golden_age.ev.windfall.3.save.note: The money fills the holes at home first.
golden_age.ev.windfall.4: A Turn of Fortune · The Festival
golden_age.ev.windfall.4.text: At the Flower Festival your portrait takes the prize, and the reward is rich.
golden_age.ev.windfall.4.invest.note: You buy the whole lane a round.
golden_age.ev.windfall.4.save.note: You hide the reward and tell no one.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.1.text: Your most trusted apprentice deserts to your rival, taking your composition drafts.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.1.confront.note: He flushes and admits it; the bond is severed.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.1.plan.note: You show nothing and wait for him to falter.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.2.text: A friend you trusted signed his name on your painting and sent it to the gallery.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.2.confront.note: The gallery pulls the work; the friendship ends.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.2.plan.note: You keep a card up your sleeve for another day.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.3.text: Someone at the salon carried your private words out, seasoned and enlarged.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.3.confront.note: The room gasps; you make an enemy.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.3.plan.note: You smile and remember each one.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.4.text: Your merchant partner absconds with the sale money, leaving only an IOU.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.4.confront.note: You recover half, and never trust a partner again.
golden_age.ev.betrayal.4.plan.note: You keep the IOU for the day he needs you.
golden_age.ev.festival.1.text: It is the Flower Festival; the market never sleeps, and hands are short for hanging paintings.
golden_age.ev.festival.1.join.note: You drink to a buzz and meet many people.
golden_age.ev.festival.1.work.note: You work alone in the studio—quiet, and a little lonely.
golden_age.ev.festival.2.text: On Lantern Night the shore lights lamps all night; painters are hired to paint lanterns.
golden_age.ev.festival.2.join.note: Your lantern hangs from a mast.
golden_age.ev.festival.2.work.note: You find it noisy and miss the chance at fame.
golden_age.ev.festival.3.text: The Grand Gallery holds its anniversary; the whole city's notables come.
golden_age.ev.festival.3.join.note: You seize the chance to show your work to patrons.
golden_age.ev.festival.3.work.note: Not one of your paintings is seen.
golden_age.ev.festival.4.text: Muses' Court holds a poetry evening; your friends hope you will come.
golden_age.ev.festival.4.join.note: You illustrate for a poet; your name spreads.
golden_age.ev.festival.4.work.note: Deaf to it all, you finish a whole set of studies.
golden_age.ev.rumor.1.text: In the tavern someone says you stole another's composition.
golden_age.ev.rumor.1.ignore.note: You pay it no mind, and it fades.
golden_age.ev.rumor.1.trace.note: You find the source: a rival's design.
golden_age.ev.rumor.2.text: On the square's notice board hangs a lampoon about your lowborn painting.
golden_age.ev.rumor.2.ignore.note: You tear it off; it is back by morning.
golden_age.ev.rumor.2.trace.note: You flush out the writer—a rival you had beaten.
golden_age.ev.rumor.3.text: Someone informs the church that your icons are not devout enough.
golden_age.ev.rumor.3.ignore.note: You will not argue; you put your heart into the work.
golden_age.ev.rumor.3.trace.note: You call the old organist to witness; the storm passes.
golden_age.ev.rumor.4.text: Salon gossip says you rose on some lady's arm.
golden_age.ev.rumor.4.ignore.note: The less you care, the more they think you are admitting it.
golden_age.ev.rumor.4.trace.note: You set the record straight before all; the lady is offended.
golden_age.ev.journey.1.text: A caravan is about to set out on the highway to the next city.
golden_age.ev.journey.1.go.note: Dust and wind, and you see other places' colors.
golden_age.ev.journey.1.stay.note: You stay in the city; the days go on as before.
golden_age.ev.journey.2.text: Someone asks you over the mountain, to see a sunset only foreign lands have.
golden_age.ev.journey.2.go.note: Beyond it you paint the most moving light of your life.
golden_age.ev.journey.2.stay.note: You return to the city with a hollow in your chest.
golden_age.ev.journey.3.text: A ship will sail across the sea; the captain will take you along.
golden_age.ev.journey.3.go.note: Months at sea bring back a new world.
golden_age.ev.journey.3.stay.note: The ship sails; you stare after the sails a long while.
golden_age.ev.journey.4.text: A pilgrimage will pass through three cities; many offer to join.
golden_age.ev.journey.4.go.note: In a sanctuary you see the masters' originals.
golden_age.ev.journey.4.stay.note: You stay and revise your old drafts three times.
golden_age.ev.duel.1.text: A rival challenges you before the square: who paints the same subject better.
golden_age.ev.duel.1.fight.note: You paint three days and nights and win the crowd.
golden_age.ev.duel.1.decline.note: You bow out, and are called timid.
golden_age.ev.duel.2.text: At the gallery's judging, someone belittles your technique before all.
golden_age.ev.duel.2.decline.note: You say nothing, go home, and drill that one stroke a hundred times.
golden_age.ev.duel.3.text: Two painters argue red-faced over who paints more truly, and ask you to judge.
golden_age.ev.duel.3.fight.note: Your side wins; the other resents you.
golden_age.ev.duel.3.decline.note: You offend no one, and no one thanks you.
golden_age.ev.duel.4.text: A sailor taunts you, saying the ship you painted could never float.
golden_age.ev.duel.4.fight.note: You draw the waterline before all; the sailor concedes.
golden_age.ev.duel.4.decline.note: You shake your head and walk off; he keeps shouting.
golden_age.ev.harvest.1.text: Cider Hill has a rich harvest, and the growers quarrel over who gets more.
golden_age.ev.harvest.1.share.note: You speak for the poor and win hearts.
golden_age.ev.harvest.1.hoard.note: You hoard a barnful and earn your neighbors' grudge.
golden_age.ev.harvest.2.text: Grain prices ride the harvest; the steward asks whether to hoard or sell.
golden_age.ev.harvest.2.share.note: You sell fairly and become the kindly talk of the lanes.
golden_age.ev.harvest.2.hoard.note: You hold a full store, and a full measure of resentment.
golden_age.ev.harvest.3.text: The press had a good harvest, and the owner will share with those who helped.
golden_age.ev.harvest.3.share.note: You give your share to a poorer fellow.
golden_age.ev.harvest.3.hoard.note: You take it all; the press-house looks at you differently.
golden_age.ev.harvest.4.text: The Court's trees bear fruit, and children gather for a bite.
golden_age.ev.harvest.4.share.note: The children's laughter is sweeter than the fruit.
golden_age.ev.harvest.4.hoard.note: You boil the fruit into pigment; no one tastes a thing.
golden_age.ev.law.1.text: The guild issues a rule: the unmastered may not sell paintings in public.
golden_age.ev.law.1.obey.note: You fold up your stall and wait to be mastered.
golden_age.ev.law.1.defy.note: You are fined, and keep your clients.
golden_age.ev.law.2.text: The town hall taxes pigment shops; a price rise is unavoidable.
golden_age.ev.law.2.obey.note: You pay honestly; half your margin is gone.
golden_age.ev.law.2.defy.note: You buy under the table—cheaper, and risky.
golden_age.ev.law.3.text: The church decrees that no painter outside it may paint icons.
golden_age.ev.law.3.obey.note: You turn to secular figures and open new ground.
golden_age.ev.law.3.defy.note: You take icons in secret and become the church's thorn.
golden_age.ev.law.4.text: The gallery rules that exhibitors must have a sponsor's backing.
golden_age.ev.law.4.obey.note: You bow your head, find a sponsor, and enter the hall.
golden_age.ev.law.4.defy.note: You hang your work in the street; the crowd is bigger.
golden_age.ev.first_love.1.text: On the night of the Flower Festival you meet, in Muses' Court, one who makes your heart race.
golden_age.ev.first_love.1.woo.note: You paint her a small portrait; she keeps it.
golden_age.ev.first_love.1.friend.note: You become confidants with nothing hidden.
golden_age.ev.first_love.2.text: At dusk on Bright Shore, a pearl-seller smiles at you.
golden_age.ev.first_love.2.woo.note: You ask her to model, and paint the brightest skin of your life.
golden_age.ev.first_love.2.friend.note: You paint her into the background; no one recognizes her.
golden_age.ev.first_love.3.text: In the Garden, an apprentice sketching shares your bench.
golden_age.ev.first_love.3.friend.note: You nod, and each paints quietly.
golden_age.ev.first_love.4.text: In the Flower Market, the one who hands you a bouquet is unforgettable.
golden_age.ev.first_love.4.woo.note: You catch up, and gain a companion.
golden_age.ev.first_love.4.friend.note: You take the flowers and go, and regret it years later.
golden_age.ev.grief.1.text: The old painter who taught you has died; the whole city's painters see him off.
golden_age.ev.grief.1.mourn.note: You paint his death portrait, weeping too hard to steady the brush.
golden_age.ev.grief.1.carry.note: You press sorrow into the brush and paint all day.
golden_age.ev.grief.2.text: Your model, the Muse, comes no more; they say she married far away.
golden_age.ev.grief.2.mourn.note: You paint the empty chair and title it 'The Absence.'
golden_age.ev.grief.2.carry.note: You go and find a new model.
golden_age.ev.grief.3.text: A pigment-maker you knew dies, leaving a room of unclaimed pigment.
golden_age.ev.grief.3.carry.note: You buy his pigment, as a kind of memorial.
golden_age.ev.grief.4.text: The old man on Cider Hill is gone; he brought you new wine every year.
golden_age.ev.grief.4.mourn.note: You leave a flask of his favorite wine at the grave.
golden_age.ev.grief.4.carry.note: You paint the chair he always sat in.
golden_age.ev.craft.1.text: A pigment-maker invites you into a partnership to brew a rare green.
golden_age.ev.craft.1.take.note: The green you make turns every painter in the city green with envy.
golden_age.ev.craft.1.refuse.note: You fear distraction and keep to your old recipe.
golden_age.ev.craft.2.text: A gold-beater asks you to learn his craft, saying gold is immortal.
golden_age.ev.craft.2.take.note: You learn gilding, and your surfaces turn expensive.
golden_age.ev.craft.2.refuse.note: You decline, fearing the craft will distract your hand.
golden_age.ev.craft.3.text: A binder invites you to make an illuminated book; you would paint the miniatures.
golden_age.ev.craft.3.take.note: The book becomes a treasure of the city.
golden_age.ev.craft.3.refuse.note: You find collaboration a nuisance and paint through the night alone.
golden_age.ev.craft.4.text: An old brush-maker wants to pass on his craft, asking only that it not die.
golden_age.ev.craft.4.take.note: Your brushes later become the guild standard.
golden_age.ev.craft.4.refuse.note: The old man puts away his tools in disappointment.
golden_age.ev.secret.1.text: In the confessional you overhear a secret you should not have.
golden_age.ev.secret.1.open.note: You let it slip, and trouble finds you.
golden_age.ev.secret.1.leave.note: You keep your mouth shut, and always feel watched.
golden_age.ev.secret.2.text: You discover that the famous, widely praised painting was actually done by an apprentice.
golden_age.ev.secret.2.open.note: The truth breaks; the price halves.
golden_age.ev.secret.2.leave.note: You stay silent and leave the question to time.
golden_age.ev.secret.3.text: A lady asks you to hide a letter that must not see the light.
golden_age.ev.secret.3.open.note: The letter reaches them; a storm breaks.
golden_age.ev.secret.3.leave.note: You lock it in the deepest corner of your paint box.
golden_age.ev.secret.4.text: At the docks you catch someone smuggling unsigned paintings out by night.
golden_age.ev.secret.4.open.note: The guild follows the thread and cuts the line.
golden_age.ev.secret.4.leave.note: You walk away, and dream of that ship at night.
golden_age.ev.gift.1.text: A noble you have never met sends a whole crate of fine pigment, namelessly.
golden_age.ev.gift.1.accept.note: You take it, as though pie fell from the sky.
golden_age.ev.gift.1.suspect.note: You fear it is adulterated and use not a drop.
golden_age.ev.gift.2.text: At the Flower Festival someone leaves a bouquet and a note at your studio door.
golden_age.ev.gift.2.accept.note: The note says only, may you paint better.
golden_age.ev.gift.2.suspect.note: You search half the day and never learn who.
golden_age.ev.gift.3.text: A rival suddenly gives you a famous painting, calling it mutual regard.
golden_age.ev.gift.3.accept.note: You keep it; he tells everyone he made you.
golden_age.ev.gift.3.suspect.note: You send it back; the two of you become enemies.
golden_age.ev.gift.4.text: A captain presses on you a crate of rare pigment from overseas.
golden_age.ev.gift.4.accept.note: With it you paint colors you never had.
golden_age.ev.gift.4.suspect.note: You fear it is ill-gotten and return it unopened.
golden_age.ev.drought.1.text: The garden's sap dries up, and the city's supply of green runs out.
golden_age.ev.drought.1.ration.note: You count every drop; you paint slower, and more carefully.
golden_age.ev.drought.1.take.note: You spend your all on one jar—painful, but it eases the need.
golden_age.ev.drought.2.text: The merchant ships are late; ultramarine at Bright Shore climbs to the sky.
golden_age.ev.drought.2.ration.note: Your paintings lose their air of wealth.
golden_age.ev.drought.2.take.note: You buy the ultramarine; your account hits bottom.
golden_age.ev.drought.3.text: War cuts the trade roads; the pigment shops of the Flower Market close one by one.
golden_age.ev.drought.3.ration.note: You scrape the last of the pigment, again and again.
golden_age.ev.drought.3.take.note: You comb the whole city to scrape together one painting.
golden_age.ev.drought.4.text: A damp spell has brought most of your studio's pigment to ruin.
golden_age.ev.drought.4.ration.note: You dry the damp pigment for three days.
golden_age.ev.drought.4.take.note: You simply start grinding your own minerals.
golden_age.ev.war.1.text: A neighboring state goes to war with the city; the walls begin to recruit night watchmen.
golden_age.ev.war.1.serve.note: You are mustered into the militia and grow used to the spear at night.
golden_age.ev.war.1.hide.note: You stow your easel in the cellar and pass for a pauper.
golden_age.ev.war.2.text: War bulletins cover the square; the city panics, and painting prices fall.
golden_age.ev.war.2.serve.note: You paint the general's banners and earn a reward.
golden_age.ev.war.2.hide.note: You shut yourself in and live on your savings.
golden_age.ev.war.3.text: Enemy ships close on the shore; everyone is fleeing the city.
golden_age.ev.war.3.serve.note: You stay to map the defenses; you take a wound in the leg.
golden_age.ev.war.3.hide.note: You flee, and return to find your studio looted.
golden_age.ev.war.4.text: The church becomes a hospital for the wounded; the priest begs the painters for help.
golden_age.ev.war.4.serve.note: You paint death portraits of the fallen, every stroke heavy.
golden_age.ev.war.4.hide.note: You cannot bear the blood and turn away.
golden_age.ev.famine.1.text: War has wrecked the grain price; famine spreads through the poor quarter.
golden_age.ev.famine.1.share.note: You open your stores; your own household hits bottom.
golden_age.ev.famine.1.close.note: You lock the grain chest and listen to the weeping outside.
golden_age.ev.famine.2.text: Grain prices soar; men come to blows over half a sack of flour.
golden_age.ev.famine.2.share.note: Your name is spoken kindly in the lanes.
golden_age.ev.famine.2.close.note: You keep your family fed, and dare not go out.
golden_age.ev.famine.3.text: The church opens a soup kitchen, and lacks hands.
golden_age.ev.famine.3.share.note: You ladle the soup and save many children.
golden_age.ev.famine.3.close.note: You pass the kitchen and quicken your step.
golden_age.ev.famine.4.text: The orchard fails; only a few fruits are left on one tree.
golden_age.ev.famine.4.share.note: You give the fruit to the sick child next door.
golden_age.ev.famine.4.close.note: You carry them home and share them with your children.
golden_age.ev.tradition.1.text: The guild will hold its centenary Brush Rite, and you are named to attend.
golden_age.ev.tradition.1.keep.note: You keep the form, and the elders nod to you.
golden_age.ev.tradition.1.break.note: You speak new words aloud; a silence falls over the table.
golden_age.ev.tradition.2.text: Your teacher's rule: wash your hands three times before you begin.
golden_age.ev.tradition.2.keep.note: You keep it for years, and your hand is steadier for it.
golden_age.ev.tradition.2.break.note: You find it tedious and stop washing your hands.
golden_age.ev.tradition.3.text: An old custom of the Flower Festival: a painter paints the first child he sees.
golden_age.ev.tradition.3.keep.note: The child you paint smiles all day.
golden_age.ev.tradition.3.break.note: You break precedent, and the elders grumble.
golden_age.ev.tradition.4.text: The old painters insist: icons must be painted on a full gold ground.
golden_age.ev.tradition.4.keep.note: Your gold ground is grave and striking.
golden_age.ev.tradition.4.break.note: You paint on a plain ground and are called a heretic.
golden_age.ev.legacy.1.text: As the years add up, you begin to ask: what should I leave behind?
golden_age.ev.legacy.1.write.note: Your notebooks become required reading for apprentices.
golden_age.ev.legacy.1.silent.note: You write nothing, and leave only your paintings.
golden_age.ev.legacy.2.text: The gallery asks you for a retrospective of your life's work.
golden_age.ev.legacy.2.write.note: On each painting you inscribe the road you traveled.
golden_age.ev.legacy.3.text: A young apprentice begs you to take him on.
golden_age.ev.legacy.3.write.note: You pass on all a lifetime's tricks.
golden_age.ev.legacy.3.silent.note: You hold something back, fearing he'll surpass you.
golden_age.ev.legacy.4.text: The church asks you for a timeless icon.
golden_age.ev.legacy.4.write.note: That icon becomes the peak of your life.
golden_age.ev.legacy.4.silent.note: You dash it off; the icon gathers dust for years.
golden_age.ev.temptation.1.text: A noble offers fame and money if you'll vouch for his collection.
golden_age.ev.temptation.1.resist.note: You speak the truth and offend the noble.
golden_age.ev.temptation.1.yield.note: You take the money and sleep badly.
golden_age.ev.temptation.2.text: The gallery hints that a bribe to the judges would hang your work dead center.
golden_age.ev.temptation.2.resist.note: Your work hangs in the corner, but you sleep soundly.
golden_age.ev.temptation.2.yield.note: Your work hangs dead center, and no one truly looks.
golden_age.ev.temptation.3.text: Someone offers a drugged cup, saying it will let you paint a masterpiece.
golden_age.ev.temptation.3.resist.note: You refuse, and paint through the night at the studio.
golden_age.ev.temptation.3.yield.note: In the vision you paint something strange; sober, you never can again.
golden_age.ev.temptation.4.text: A married noble makes you an ambiguous invitation.
golden_age.ev.temptation.4.resist.note: You plead your painting and decline.
golden_age.ev.temptation.4.yield.note: A secret entanglement drains your spirit.
golden_age.ev.rescue.1.text: At the sunset pier, a child loses footing and falls into the water.
golden_age.ev.rescue.1.help.note: You pull him out, soaked through, and warm inside.
golden_age.ev.rescue.1.pass.note: You call the boatmen; the child is saved, and you never entered the water.
golden_age.ev.rescue.2.text: A fire starts next door to your studio; an old man is trapped inside.
golden_age.ev.rescue.2.help.note: You carry the old man out through the flames and burn your arm.
golden_age.ev.rescue.2.pass.note: By the time the brigade arrives, the old man is gone.
golden_age.ev.rescue.3.text: A stranger is cornered by thugs in the street.
golden_age.ev.rescue.3.help.note: You free him, and he becomes your lifelong friend.
golden_age.ev.rescue.3.pass.note: You hurry away; looking back, he lies in a pool of blood.
golden_age.ev.rescue.4.text: On a snowy night, a faint knock comes at your door.
golden_age.ev.rescue.4.help.note: You shelter a lost traveler, who later repays a meal with a fortune.
golden_age.ev.rescue.4.pass.note: The knocking stops, and you lie awake all night.
golden_age.ev.bargain.1.text: A captain wants to trade a crate of spice for the small painting you carry.
golden_age.ev.bargain.1.deal.note: The spice sells on for a good price.
golden_age.ev.bargain.1.walk.note: You think him no judge of art and turn on your heel.
golden_age.ev.bargain.2.text: The dealer haggles hard; you are near to losing money.
golden_age.ev.bargain.2.deal.note: You sell, and get the cash to keep going.
golden_age.ev.bargain.2.walk.note: The painting doesn't sell—and then a buyer who knows his trade appears.
golden_age.ev.bargain.3.text: Someone offers a high price for your discarded drafts, calling them 'collector's proofs.'
golden_age.ev.bargain.3.deal.note: The drafts fetch a good price, and leave you uneasy.
golden_age.ev.bargain.3.walk.note: You take the drafts back, sensing a swindle.
golden_age.ev.bargain.4.text: The gallery owner proposes a cut harsher than custom.
golden_age.ev.bargain.4.deal.note: You sign; the work sells well, and you take little.
golden_age.ev.bargain.4.walk.note: You change galleries and never deal with him again.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.1.text: On a stormy night the waves top Bright Shore, and a ship signals for help.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.1.shelter.note: You keep behind the window, listening to the cries at sea.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.1.self.note: You charge into the wind and rain and save two lives.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.2.text: The wind tears off your studio roof, and rain pours in.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.2.shelter.note: You haul canvases through the rain; a few still get soaked.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.2.self.note: You duck into the dry inner room and let the paintings take the rain.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.3.text: The wind blows out every street lamp, and someone cries out in the dark.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.3.shelter.note: You reach home in the dark, unharmed.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.3.self.note: In a dark alley you lift a fallen old man.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.4.text: In the storm you remember a batch of paintings still drying in the Court.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.4.shelter.note: By morning the paintings are ruined.
golden_age.ev.storm_night.4.self.note: You are soaked to the bone, but half the paintings are saved.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.1.text: The academy opens a new course in perspective, for sponsored painters only.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.1.study.note: You wear down three months and finally enter the lecture hall.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.2.text: The old library holds a lost manuscript on composition.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.2.study.note: You copy the whole volume, and your skill leaps.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.2.play.note: You read in a trance, but never set brush to paper.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.3.text: A retired master will take one apprentice, tested by a single question.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.3.study.note: You answer beautifully and become his last apprentice.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.3.play.note: You give up; the master takes no one.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.4.text: The merchants' guild will fund one painter to study overseas; there is but one place.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.4.study.note: You win the place and sail far from home.
golden_age.ev.scholarship.4.play.note: You yield the chance to someone more gifted.
golden_age.ev.honor.1.text: The guild will name you 'Painter of the City,' sworn publicly to loyalty.
golden_age.ev.honor.1.accept.note: You wear the badge, and the binding.
golden_age.ev.honor.1.decline.note: You refuse, and are lighter for it.
golden_age.ev.honor.2.text: The church would crown you 'First of Icon-Painters.'
golden_age.ev.honor.2.accept.note: Your prices double, and your freedom halves.
golden_age.ev.honor.2.decline.note: You paint on in silence, and your name speaks for itself.
golden_age.ev.honor.3.text: The citizens wish to raise a bust of you in the square.
golden_age.ev.honor.3.accept.note: The bronze stands in the square—and so does the gossip.
golden_age.ev.honor.3.decline.note: You urge them to spend the money on a school instead.
golden_age.ev.honor.4.text: Fellow painters nominate you as the guild's warden.
golden_age.ev.honor.4.decline.note: You keep to your painting, and your peace.
golden_age.ev.lost.1.text: Your paint box has vanished at the docks.
golden_age.ev.lost.1.call.note: You learn a porter took it by mistake.
golden_age.ev.lost.1.wait.note: The box is returned, nothing missing.
golden_age.ev.lost.2.text: Your dog has strayed from you at the street corner.
golden_age.ev.lost.2.call.note: Someone brings the dog back; you thank him richly.
golden_age.ev.lost.2.wait.note: You find it curled up at the alley's end.
golden_age.ev.lost.3.text: The little portrait pendant the Muse gave you is gone.
golden_age.ev.lost.3.call.note: You find it at the bottom of the pigment chest.
golden_age.ev.lost.3.wait.note: You never find it, and keep its likeness in your mind.
golden_age.ev.lost.4.text: An old man found your purse and waits at the church door.
golden_age.ev.lost.4.call.note: You thank him richly, and gain a fast friend.
golden_age.ev.lost.4.wait.note: You fear a trap, thank him, and leave.
golden_age.ev.dream.1.text: You dream of a perfect painting, and wake unable to recall its details.
golden_age.ev.dream.1.follow.note: You paint the dream's afterimage, and it becomes a favorite.
golden_age.ev.dream.1.wake.note: You shake your head and take other work.
golden_age.ev.dream.2.text: In a dream, a white-robed figure shows you a color you have never seen.
golden_age.ev.dream.2.follow.note: You mix that color, and are famous for a while.
golden_age.ev.dream.2.wake.note: You pay it no mind, and forget the dream entirely.
golden_age.ev.dream.3.text: You dream that your late teacher waits for you in the Court.
golden_age.ev.dream.3.follow.note: In the dream he gives you a single hint.
golden_age.ev.dream.3.wake.note: You wake, remembering only a pang of loss.
golden_age.ev.dream.4.text: You dream that a ship you painted truly puts out to sea.
golden_age.ev.dream.4.follow.note: You paint the dreamed ship down to the last rope.
golden_age.ev.dream.4.wake.note: You call it a daydream and go on with your work.
golden_age.ev.bet.1.text: In the tavern someone bets you can't paint a street scene from memory.
golden_age.ev.bet.1.match.note: Eyes closed, you paint the whole street and win the room.
golden_age.ev.bet.1.fold.note: You shake your head—lost face, not money.
golden_age.ev.bet.2.text: Two rivals bet on whether you can finish a large painting in one night.
golden_age.ev.bet.2.match.note: You pull an all-nighter, and finish it.
golden_age.ev.bet.2.fold.note: You refuse to be a pawn and walk away.
golden_age.ev.bet.3.text: A collector bets you'll be famous within three years; the stake is large.
golden_age.ev.bet.3.match.note: You wager on yourself, and three years later it comes true.
golden_age.ev.bet.3.fold.note: You think fame is not worth a gamble.
golden_age.ev.bet.4.text: The sailors bet you dare not paint the sea in a storm.
golden_age.ev.bet.4.match.note: You paint the storm on deck and nearly fall overboard.
golden_age.ev.bet.4.fold.note: You don't gamble against the sky, and come ashore safely.
golden_age.ev.hermit.1.text: They say an old painter who refused office lives in the hills.
golden_age.ev.hermit.1.learn.note: He teaches you how to see a mountain; it serves you all your life.
golden_age.ev.hermit.1.mock.note: You mock his aloofness—and secretly envy it.
golden_age.ev.hermit.2.text: A strange man living alone by the sea paints incomparable work.
golden_age.ev.hermit.2.learn.note: He lets you stand and watch him paint.
golden_age.ev.hermit.2.mock.note: You dismiss his words as nonsense.
golden_age.ev.hermit.3.text: In a corner of the Court, an old man sits alone, all day, every day.
golden_age.ev.hermit.3.learn.note: He tells you one sentence worth a fortune.
golden_age.ev.hermit.4.text: In the back pew sits a man who never speaks.
golden_age.ev.hermit.4.learn.note: He turns out to be a master who burned all his paintings.
golden_age.ev.hermit.4.mock.note: You never exchange a single word.
golden_age.ev.quiet.text: The days are calm; the brush whispers over the paper.
golden_age.ev.omen.text: By night you see a strange light, and cannot tell if it bodes well or ill.
golden_age.ev.dread.text: An unaccountable unease presses on your heart.
golden_age.ev.bounty.text: An unexpected sum of money lands in your pocket.
golden_age.ev.weariness.text: You hold the brush, and cannot summon the strength.
